description:
Get EDGAR filing detail

Return normalized EDGAR filing metadata for a specific filing. Future versions may include normalized statement and long-form payloads.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

include_long_form.description: Reserved for future normalized long-form payload; currently ignored.

include_statements.description: Reserved for future use; currently ignored.

name: edgar_companies_filings_get
